{"question": "How does Rootsignal decide that two failures belong to the same issue?"}

Rootsignal decides that two failures belong to the same issue if they are the same problem, scoped to an environment. This means that the same failure in staging and production would give two issues. The system uses advisory locks to group runs inside the detection job's transaction and ensure that two workers grouping into the same issue serialize and don't deadlock each other. [docs/ISSUES.md]
